mentions.name: Colibri
mentions.description: This is an open source, self-hostable ebook library for individuals and their family and friends. It provides professionally gathered, automatic bibliographical metadata, direct reader connectivity, calibre sync, OPDS support, an optional public 'bragging shelf', and high quality install packages. It is explicitly meant to stay un-monetized.
mentions.problem: People who love reading need an easy way to access their ebook collection and share it with a few people.
mentions.audience: Readers who want an easy way to access their ebook collection and share it with family and friends.
mentions.source_excerpt: An open source, self-hostable ebook library for yourself, and/or family and friends. mentions.name: Colibri
mentions.description: A self-hostable web application for managing personal and family ebook libraries, built as a companion to Calibre. It lets users review their books, add metadata, get books onto their reader, share them with family and a few friends, create a public shelf, connect with Goodreads, and exchange comments and reviews on books. It is explicitly not intended to be monetised.
mentions.source_excerpt: Colibri—a self-hostable web application to manage your (and your family's) ebook library, intended as a companion to Calibre.
